verdict.rationale: Reducto's enterprise docs list a dedicated VPC deployment, a hybrid VPC model and air-gapped options alongside SaaS, so the core product can run in customer infrastructure. However, the one described model keeps data in the customer's VPC while processing runs on Reducto's own GPU infrastructure. All of these options appear to be enterprise-tier arrangements rather than something an individual user can self-host. Missing for 10: self-serve self-hosting outside enterprise contracts, installation and deployment documentation, detail on how the fully on-prem or air-gapped mode works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
